description: This PHP file contains a test class NotesCest used for acceptance testing of the Notes module in a SuiteCRM project. It employs the Codeception testing framework to perform UI tests, including setup for mock data using Faker and a test scenario for viewing the notes module.

classes.name: NotesCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Notes module using Codeception framework. Sets up fake data and includes a test scenario for viewing the notes module.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Pre-test setup to initialize fake data generator and seed it with a random seed.

methods.name: testScenarioViewNotesModule
methods.description: Test scenario that logs in as admin, navigates to the notes list view, and verifies the module title is visible.
